citations.text: Atlas delivery performance target is 95% on-time shipments per calendar month. Delivered on or before the promised date means on-time. A missed target triggers a carrier review. Monetary credits require contract-owner approval; no automatic credit amount is specified.

citations.title: Atlas February disruption log
citations.text: The February Atlas incident register records repeated vehicle breakdown and weather exceptions on late shipments. Investigators must link each incident to shipment IDs before drawing conclusions about the causes of the performance decline.

citations.title: Delivery performance calculation
citations.text: On-time delivery rate is 100 multiplied by on-time shipments divided by total delivered shipments in the calendar month. Changes between percentages are reported in percentage points. No rate can be calculated without records.

citations.title: Delivery punctuality reporting
citations.text: Punctuality measures whether shipments reached customers on or before the promised delivery date. A punctual arrival is an on-time delivery. Missed arrival promises count as late shipments.
